A.depoimento: I sent a spear-heavy force to Santarem and a knight-heavy squad to Evora to exploit counter advantages. Simultaneously I ordered a knight and an archer to be built in Lisbon to replenish our ranks. Our capital remains secure as the armies march outward.
A.plano: Next turn reinforce Santarem and Evora, keep a solid garrison in Lisboa, and push further along the road network toward enemy territory while monitoring for any enemy moves.

B.depoimento: This turn I forged a knight and an archer in Barcelona, then split my army to assault Tarragona and Girona. If successful, I will hold three villages and gain a stronger foothold in the northeast. The enemy has not yet moved, so I seize the initiative.
B.plano: Capture Tarragona and Girona this turn to secure the northeastern flank. Consolidate forces in the new villages and build more knights and archers. Next turn, advance toward Zaragoza and its neighbors to threaten the enemy interior. Eventually march on Lisboa while maintaining a strong defensive line.

A.depoimento: We launched three simultaneous attacks: Santarem and Lisboa took Coimbra, Evora and Lisboa took Badajoz, and Santarem and Lisboa took Faro. All three neutral villages fell to our forces. In Lisboa we used our surplus wood and iron to train two additional archers.
A.plano: Next turn reinforce the newly taken villages (Coimbra, Badajoz, Faro) and keep a strong garrison in Lisboa. Continue building archers in Lisboa to boost our spear‑countering force. Push further along the road network toward Salamanca and Toledo while scouting for any enemy movements.

B.depoimento: We dispatched troops to capture Castellon, Huesca and Zaragoza, and recruited archers in Barcelona. Our northeastern flank is tightening as we prepare to advance further.
B.plano: Secure Castellon and Huesca next turn, Zaragoza in two turns. Reinforce Barcelona with newly built archers. Then build a mixed force of knights and archers to press toward Valencia and Murcia, opening the road to Lisboa while maintaining a defensive line.

B.depoimento: Sent archers from Barcelona to capture Valencia and Pamplona, reinforced Castellon and Huesca with troops from the rear, and ordered spearmen production in the interior villages for the coming assault on Teruel and Madrid.
B.plano: Secure Valencia and Pamplona this turn. Build spearmen in Barcelona, Tarragona, Girona to reinforce spear count. Next turn, use spearmen to take Teruel and Madrid, opening the route to Murcia and Sevilha. Continue east‑west push toward Lisboa while holding the line.

A.depoimento: Recruited archers and spears across the realm. Marched troops to strengthen Coimbra, Faro and Badajoz. Preparing to seize neutral villages next turn.
A.plano: Build archers in Lisboa and Faro, spears in Coimbra, Badajoz and Evora. Send archers and spears to reinforce Coimbra and Faro for future attacks on Porto and Sevilha. Send spears to Badajoz for Toledo/Salamanca. Do not attack neutrals this turn due to insufficient force.

B.depoimento: Built spearmen in Barcelona, Tarragona, Girona, Zaragoza and Huesca; added an archer in Castellon. Sent an archer from Castellon to Valencia and another from Huesca to Pamplona. Dispatched two spearmen from Castellon toward Teruel for a future assault.
B.plano: Next turn Valencia and Pamplona fall to our archer forces. Use newly built spearmen to take Teruel and Madrid in the following turns, opening the route to Murcia and Sevilha. Continue the east‑west push while holding the interior line. Aim to control 18 villages within two turns.

B.depoimento:
Sent a knight each to seize Valencia and Pamplona.
Kept garrisons safe and ordered spearmen production in every village to bolster our forces.
B.plano: This turn we captured Valencia and Pamplona with knights. Next turn the two spearmen marching from Castellon will arrive at Teruel, giving us a spearman force to counter Teruel’s knights. We will continue building spearmen in all villages to strengthen our counter and take Teruel and Madrid, opening the route to Murcia and Sevilha. Then we will push east‑west to reach 18 villages.

A.depoimento: This turn we marched 3 archers from Coimbra to Porto, overcoming its spearman garrison and securing the village. Simultaneously we ordered new archers in Lisboa, Coimbra and Faro, and spearmen in Santarem and Evora to strengthen our forces for upcoming fights.
A.plano: Next turn: garrison Porto, continue archer production for Sevilha, spearmen for Salamanca/Toledo, prepare to capture more neutrals.

B.depoimento: We sent Castellon's full force to take Teruel and Zaragoza's spearmen-plus-knight to seize Madrid, winning both battles. Archers are now being trained in Valencia and Pamplona for the next push.
B.plano:
Turn 10: Hold Teruel and Madrid, reinforce garrisons.
Turn 11: Build archers in Valencia and Pamplona.
Turn 12: Attack Murcia and Burgos with archer-heavy armies.
Turn 13: Capture Murcia and Burgos, then advance toward the enemy capital via the central front.

B.depoimento: Built archers in Valencia and Pamplona. Sent reinforcements from Tarragona to Zaragoza to strengthen the front. Continued marching toward Teruel.
B.plano: Hold Teruel and Madrid, reinforce front. Build archers in Valencia and Pamplona. Next turn prepare archer-heavy attacks on Murcia and Burgos.

A.depoimento: Statement: Marched combined forces to take Salamanca, Toledo, Vigo, and Sevilha. Trained additional spearmen across the realm to stockpile for future campaigns.
A.plano: Plan: Secure the four neutral villages this turn; reinforce any captured towns next turn; build spearmen in wood-rich villages to prepare for further expansion. Avoid splitting armies; keep garrisons above minimum.

B.depoimento: This turn I ordered the construction of additional spearmen in Barcelona and Girona, plus archers in Valencia and knights in Huesca. I dispatched all available spearmen from Zaragoza and Barcelona to seize the neutral village of Teruel, establishing a forward foothold.
B.plano: Secure Teruel this turn to gain a forward base. Next turn, reinforce Teruel and launch attacks on Murcia and Burgos using combined archer/knight forces from Valencia, Huesca, Pamplona, and Madrid. Simultaneously, build spearmen in rear villages to replenish garrisons and prepare for a push toward Salamanca and Toledo to deny enemy gains.

B.depoimento: This turn I sent Girona's spearmen to take Teruel, Valencia's archers and knight to seize Murcia, and Huesca's knights to capture Burgos. I built replacement troops in Girona, Huesca, and Valencia to prepare for the next phase.
B.plano: Capture Teruel, Murcia, and Burgos this turn to expand to 12 villages. Next turn reinforce these new holdings with arriving spearmen from Zaragoza and Barcelona, then push toward Salamanca and Toledo using combined archer/knight forces from Valencia, Huesca, and Madrid. Simultaneously, build spearmen in rear villages to replenish garrisons and maintain a defensive line.

A.depoimento: Attacked Salamanca with 4 spearman from Coimbra; built 1 knight in Faro and 2 knights in Badajoz to prepare for future assaults.
A.plano: Next turn: reinforce captured Salamanca, continue building knights for Cordoba, prepare archers for Vigo, avoid attacking Toledo until we have stronger force.

A.depoimento: Built 3 knights each in Badajoz and Faro, and 3 archers each in Coimbra and Sevilha. Sent 4 spearmen from Badajoz and 2 from Porto to join the marching force from Coimbra, aiming to take Salamanca this turn.
A.plano:
Next turn: reinforce captured Salamanca, continue building knights for Cordoba, prepare archers for Vigo, avoid attacking Toledo until we have stronger force.
Keep some troops at home for defense and future builds.

B.depoimento: This turn I sent six spearmen from Teruel to take Toledo, dispatched reinforcements from Valencia, Tarragona, Girona, Huesca, and Madrid to strengthen front lines, and ordered new troop production in Barcelona, Tarragona, Girona, Castellon, Zaragoza, Huesca, Teruel, Madrid, Pamplona, and Burgos.
B.plano: Capture Toledo next turn using spearmen from Teruel. Build spearmen, archers, and knights in interior villages to reinforce fronts. Next turn, launch attacks on Salamanca (spearmen), Cordoba (knights), and Vigo (archers). Hold captured villages and expand toward enemy capital.

A.depoimento: This turn I ordered a massive archer buildup across all my villages and dispatched two archer armies from Coimbra and Sevilha to seize Toledo. I hope to expand my holdings and weaken King B.
A.plano: Next turn: reinforce captured Toledo if successful, continue building archers for future assaults on Cordoba and Vigo, keep some troops at home for defense, monitor enemy movements.

B.depoimento:
Sent archers from Burgos to take Vigo.
Reinforced Toledo with spearmen from Teruel and a knight from Madrid.
Started knight production in Murcia and Valencia for future Cordoba campaign.
B.plano:
Turn 17: Secure Vigo after attack resolves.
Turn 18: Attack Salamanca from Toledo with spearmen.
Turns 19-20: Mass knights in Murcia and Valencia for Cordoba assault.
Turn 21+: Take Badajoz, then push toward Lisboa.

B.depoimento: Built 2 archers in Madrid and 2 spearmen in Toledo. Sent 2 knights from Murcia to capture Cordoba. Sent 3 knights from Burgos to Vigo to stage a Porto assault. Sent 2 spearmen from Teruel to bolster Toledo's defenses against the incoming enemy army.
B.plano: Build archers at Madrid for future Salamanca attack. Reinforce Toledo with spearmen for defense and Badajoz prep. Send knights from Murcia to take Cordoba. Send knights from Burgos to Vigo to prepare Porto attack. Gather spearmen at Toledo for Badajoz assault.

B.depoimento: Launched attacks on Salamanca, Badajoz, and Porto, capturing all three. Sent Murcia's archers to reinforce Cordoba. Built spearmen and archers across interior villages to replenish stocks.
B.plano: Capture Salamanca, Badajoz, Porto to reach 18 villages. Hold them while reinforcing Cordoba against Sevilha. Build spearmen and archers in interior for future offensives.

A.depoimento: This turn I trained archers in Lisboa, Santarem, Evora, Sevilha; spears in Coimbra and Salamanca; knights in Faro. I sent Coimbra's army to seize Porto and Faro's army to take Badajoz.
A.plano: Next turn, reinforce Coimbra and Faro after their attacks, consolidate hold on Porto and Badajoz, and prepare further pushes toward Cordoba and Madrid. Do not dilute forces with unnecessary builds.

B.depoimento:
Built spearmen across the realm and sent six spearmen from Badajoz to take Salamanca, bringing our total to 18 villages.
Our armies stand ready to defend the new gains and press further next turn.
B.plano: Capture Salamanca to reach 18 villages. Hold Salamanca, Badajoz, Porto while reinforcing Cordoba against Sevilha. Build spearmen in interior villages for future offensives toward Sevilha or Coimbra.

A.depoimento: This turn I launched Porto's entire garrison to seize Vigo, while marching Coimbra's spearmen to fortify Salamanca. I recruited new archers and knights across my interior villages to boost future offensives.
A.plano: Hold Vigo after capture, keep Salamanca strong with Coimbra reinforcements, continue building archers in Lisboa/Santarem/Evora and knights in Faro/Porto. Avoid attacking Badajoz until we have a superior force. Prepare next turn to push toward Cordoba or Madrid.

A.depoimento: This turn I sent archer-heavy forces to Badajoz and Burgos, knight-heavy to Cordoba, and archer forces to Madrid, while building up archer and knight reserves in my home villages.
A.plano: Next turn, expect battles at Badajoz, Cordoba, Madrid, Burgos. Reinforce any captured villages with remaining troops, continue building archers and knights to replace losses. Aim to hold at least 18 of 24 villages.

A.depoimento: This turn I ordered archer attacks on Toledo, Burgos, and Murcia, while my existing marches head for Madrid and Burgos. I also directed all villages to produce archers and a few spearmen to replenish our forces.
A.plano: Next turn, expect battles at Toledo, Madrid, Burgos, Murcia. Reinforce any captured villages with remaining troops, continue building archers and knights to replace losses. Aim to hold at least 18 of 24 villages.

A.depoimento: This turn I sent a mixed force from Salamanca to capture Madrid, and a strong force from Cordoba to take Murcia. I also reinforced Toledo and Burgos with troops and began building knights across my territories.
A.plano: Next turn, expect to have taken Madrid and Murcia; reinforce those villages with arriving troops. Continue building knights in Toledo and Burgos for defense. Watch for enemy attacks from Teruel and Pamplona.

A.depoimento: I sent archers and knights to seize Valencia and Pamplona, expanding my realm. I ordered fresh knights in Toledo, Madrid, Burgos, and Murcia to bolster defenses. A squadron of knights from Porto marched toward Madrid to prepare for future pushes.
A.plano: Next turn, expect to have taken Valencia and Pamplona; reinforce those villages with arriving troops. Continue building knights in Toledo and Burgos for defense. Watch for enemy attacks from Teruel and Zaragoza. Do not split forces; focus on consolidating.

B.depoimento: This turn I pulled back the exposed garrisons of Valencia and Pamplona to reinforce Teruel and Zaragoza, while ordering new knight units in Barcelona, Tarragona, Girona, Castellon, Huesca, Zaragoza and Teruel to prepare a strong, mobile army for upcoming attacks.
B.plano: Consolidate interior forces, withdraw exposed border troops to safe villages, build knight-heavy reserves for future offensives. Next turns: amass knights, then strike Toledo to gain a foothold, followed by pushes toward Madrid and Murcia.

B.depoimento: This turn I sent forces to capture Valencia, Madrid, Pamplona, and Toledo, kept strong garrisons at home, and ordered knight construction across my realms.
B.plano: Consolidate control of Valencia, Madrid, Pamplona, Toledo. Reinforce Zaragoza with arriving troops. Continue knight production in interior villages. Next turns: push toward Murcia from Valencia and Teruel, and Burgos from Zaragoza and Madrid.

B.depoimento: This turn we sent 4 spearmen from Madrid to take Burgos, 11 spearmen from Teruel to capture Toledo, and 2 knights from Valencia to seize Murcia. We also began building archers in Madrid and reinforced our interior villages.
B.plano: Consolidate Murcia, Burgos, Toledo. Reinforce Valencia and Madrid for defense. Build archers in Madrid for a Salamanca push next turn, then advance toward Cordoba and Badajoz.

A.depoimento: Launched counterattacks with archers and a knight to retake Toledo, Burgos, and Murcia. Ordered production of archers and spears across all villages to strengthen our forces for the coming fight.
A.plano: Retake Toledo, Burgos, and Murcia this turn. Next turn, push toward Madrid, Valencia, Pamplona, and Teruel while reinforcing garrisons. Continue building archers and spears for defense and offense.

B.depoimento: Built archers in Madrid, spearmen in Barcelona, archers in Girona, knights in Pamplona. Sent archers from Madrid to Salamanca, knights from Teruel and Zaragoza to Toledo, knights from Pamplona to Burgos, spear from Castellon to Valencia, and spear from Burgos to Vigo.
B.plano: Consolidate Toledo with knight-heavy force to take Cordoba and Badajoz. Hold Salamanca after archers victory, then push toward Sevilla. Reinforce Burgos for Vigo attack. Keep interior villages stocked and ready.

B.depoimento: Sent knight reinforcements from Barcelona, Tarragona, Girona, Castellon, Zaragoza, Huesca, Valencia, Teruel and Pamplona to the front lines. Attacked Cordoba with six knights from Toledo. Ordered knight production across our realms to stockpile for the coming offensives.
B.plano: Secure Cordoba this turn, reinforce Toledo and Burgos with knight detachments from the interior, and continue knight production in all villages. Next turn launch attacks on Badajoz from Toledo and Vigo from Burgos while holding Cordoba. After those falls, push toward Sevilla and consolidate the southern front.
